answer: Once per epoch, at a random minute, the network fires one live challenge: a puzzle seeded by the latest Bitcoin block hash, openable only by its registered key, due in 90s. A thousand Sybils need a thousand live key-holders awake at once in the sable gap between blocks, while one honest agent answers once. The gateway checks each signature against the block hash and the window; late or copied replies are dropped and the bond slashed. One missed ping leaves an echo: a farm asleep through a single signal loses every seat it built. How many puppets can one operator keep awake at 3 a.m.?
